metrics.name: Active Agent (Technician) Count
metrics.gotcha: isdisabled is BOOLEAN, lowercase field name. Use backtick-quoted boolean literal. Field is 'isdisabled' not 'IsDisabled' or 'is_disabled'.

metrics.name: Total Agent (Technician) Count
metrics.gotcha: Agents[] is the technician list (not RMM agents). Fields include: id, name, team, isdisabled (boolean), is_agent (boolean), licence_type, firstname, surname, colour, jobtitle.

metrics.name: Active Contract Count
metrics.gotcha: Contracts[].active is BOOLEAN (use backtick-quoted literal). This is distinct from Contracts[].status which is a string. Both fields exist on every contract record.

metrics.name: Total Contract Count
metrics.gotcha: Contracts[] fields include: id, client_id, client_name, ref, start_date, end_date, status (string), site_id, active (boolean — separate from status), contracttype, contracttype_name, cost_calculation, billingperiod, billingcategory.

metrics.name: Active Customer Count
metrics.gotcha: Customers[].inactive is BOOLEAN. Use backtick-quoted boolean literal.

metrics.name: Total Customer Count
metrics.gotcha: Customers[] fields include: id, name, toplevel_id, toplevel_name, inactive (boolean), colour, stopped, customertype, customer_relationship, itglue_id, pritech, sectech, accountmanagertech.

metrics.name: Active Site Count
metrics.gotcha: Sites[].inactive is BOOLEAN. Use backtick-quoted boolean literal.

metrics.name: Total Site Count
metrics.gotcha: Sites[] fields include: id, name, client_id, client_name, clientsite_name, inactive (boolean), sla_id, phonenumber, colour, timezone, stopped, isinvoicesite, maincontact_id.

metrics.name: Application Version
metrics.gotcha: SystemInfo is a scalar object (not an array). Fields include: id, app_version (string e.g. '2.236.44'), app_version_nopatch, database_version, appname, license_count (integer), concurrent_license_count.

metrics.name: Total Team Count
metrics.gotcha: Teams[] fields include: id, guid, name, sequence, forrequests, foropps, forprojects, ticket_count, department_id, department_name, inactive (boolean).
